spike_results.setup: single core, arm64 mac, 200k live traces (~860MB payload window), 2.79M traces of 10 spans in 2 fragments, ~424B/span marshaled
conclusions: retained pdata disqualified: 39% GC CPU at 2.5GB live; GOGC=400 trades it for 5.6x memory inflation
marshal-on-ingest to noscan bytes eliminates GC cost: 0.2-1.4% GC CPU at same alloc rate
disk segments sustain ~3.5 Gbps/core with 179MB heap; keep-path Get p99 21us warm
next bottleneck is the trace index: ~900 B/trace all-in; needs compact design, measure in ADR-006 work
spike_results.caveats: single-threaded; count-based window; no fsync; warm page-cache reads; seg GC cycles are transient marshal buffers (GOMEMLIMIT + marshal-into-buffer to fix)
